name: Create a Checklist Item
description: Creates a new checklist item in a card. [See the documentation](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/trello/rest/api-group-checklists/#api-checklists-id-checkitems-post).

configurable_props.name: board
configurable_props.label: Board
configurable_props.description: The Trello board you wish to select

configurable_props.name: card
configurable_props.label: Card
configurable_props.description: The ID of the Card that the checklist item should be added to

configurable_props.name: name
configurable_props.label: Name
configurable_props.description: The name of the new check item on the checklist. Should be a string of length 1 to 16384.

configurable_props.name: pos
configurable_props.label: Position
configurable_props.description: The position of the checklist on the card. One of: top, bottom, or a positive number.

configurable_props.name: checked
configurable_props.label: Checked
configurable_props.description: Determines whether the check item is already checked when created.

configurable_props.name: due
configurable_props.label: Due Date
configurable_props.description: A due date for the checkitem. **Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sssZ**

configurable_props.name: dueReminder
configurable_props.label: Due Reminder
configurable_props.description: A dueReminder for the due date on the checkitem

configurable_props.name: idMember
configurable_props.label: Id Member
configurable_props.description: An ID of a member resource
